title: Role of SiO2 in enhancing CO yield by using silica-supported La0.5Ba0.5FeO3 in reverse water–gas shift chemical looping
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00416G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hanzhong Shi, Jiawei Guo, Prabhsimran Singh, Venkat R. Bhethanabotla, John N. Kuhn
Perovskite oxides facilitate CO2 conversion by reverse water–gas shift chemical looping at moderate conditions by employing an oxygen vacancy at the surface to aid CO2 adsorption and then to scavenge an oxygen atom from it to fill the vacancy.
